description: This file defines the 'Module' class for managing module updates in Drupal, including methods for installation directory retrieval, checking installation status, and update capabilities. It is deprecated in Drupal 11.2.0 and removed in 12.0.0.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A class for updating Drupal modules, handling installation paths, and update checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that triggers a deprecation warning and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: getInstallDirectory
methods.description: Returns the absolute path where a module should be installed, depending on whether it is already installed.

methods.name: getRootDirectoryRelativePath
methods.description: Returns the relative directory name for modules, 'modules'.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the module exists in the file system, regardless of enabled status.

methods.name: canUpdateDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given directory contains a module that can be updated.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Determines if a project can be updated based on its name.

methods.name: postUpdateTasks
methods.description: Placeholder for post-update tasks; currently does not perform any actions.
